briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies frontier race as compute constraints tighten globally

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while regulatory scrutiny grows. Compute shortages and export controls shape deployment timelines. AI safety investments lag behind capability gains.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 2T parameters; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind previews Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B. xAI and DeepSeek push inference optimizations.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updates AI RMF; EU AI Act enforcement begins.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm for AI chips; Microsoft and Google announce $40B data center expansions. NVIDIA Blackwell supply tightens through Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like dynamic dialect negotiation become mandatory for BCI and autonomous systems by 2028?
